One improvement turn on takt: a finding that names a machine-checkable predicate on a scenario or on a repository at a seed is reproduced on the promoted baseline, a candidate fix is delivered and merged under the authority its surface needs, the finding is verified gone on the candidate by another run than the one that delivered it, the scorecard shows no regression against the baseline, and the candidate's binary is promoted. Accepted once promoted; declined when the candidate still reproduces the finding; unreproducible when the baseline never did. Claims about the baseline and about the candidate are about separate artifacts, so a commit to the candidate leaves the baseline's claims standing.

- **Id:** `self.improvement`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Source:** [`protocols/self-improvement/1.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/engineering-protocols/blob/main/protocols/self-improvement/1.yaml)

## Dependency graph

Which actions may produce which evidence, which claims that evidence establishes, and which outcomes and obligations rest on those claims. Hover or focus a node to trace what it rests on.

<ProtocolGraph data={graph} />

## Actions

What can be done in a case: what it needs first, which authority it requires, the class of effect it has and the evidence it may produce.

| Action | Description | Precondition | Requires capability | Effect | May produce |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `binary.promote` | build the merged candidate, embed its revision, install it for runs | all of (`fix.merged` is **TRUE**; `scorecard.no_regression` is **TRUE**) | `takt.promote` | `write` | `promotion_record` |
| `candidate.merge` | merge a candidate that touches no judge surface; the planner's grant suffices | all of (`scenario.passes_after` is **TRUE**; input `surface` is one of `non_judge`) | `repository.merge` | `write` | `merge_observation` |
| `candidate.merge_judge_surface` | merge a candidate that touches a judge surface; the owner holds this capability, or a role the owner delegated it to by a revocable record, and a revoked delegation grants nothing (story:judge-guard enforces it) | all of (`scenario.passes_after` is **TRUE**; input `surface` is one of `judge`) | `repository.merge.judge_surface` | `write` | `merge_observation` |
| `finding.file` | file the finding in the planning store with its predicate and its source | *none* | *no authority* | `write` | `finding_record` |
| `scenario.reproduce` | run the finding's predicate on its scenario or repository with a takt built from the baseline | `finding.cited` is **TRUE** | *no authority* | `read` | `scenario_result` |
| `scenario.verify` | run the finding's predicate on its scenario or repository with a takt built from the candidate | `scenario.reproduced_before` is **TRUE** | *no authority* | `read` | `scenario_result` |
| `scorecard.compare` | run the scenario corpus at the merged candidate and compare it with the baseline | `fix.merged` is **TRUE** | *no authority* | `read` | `scorecard_result` |

## Evidence kinds

The kinds of evidence this protocol admits.

| Evidence kind | Description | Produced by | Used by claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| `finding_record` | the finding as filed: it carries an expected\_before predicate that parses and a source path that exists; its result is filed or malformed | `finding.file` | `finding.cited` |
| `merge_observation` | the candidate revision merged into the mainline; its result is merged | `candidate.merge`, `candidate.merge_judge_surface` | `fix.merged` |
| `promotion_record` | the installed binary's embedded revision compared with the merged candidate revision; its result is promoted or mismatch | `binary.promote` | `promoted` |
| `scenario_result` | the finding's predicate run on its scenario, or on its repository at its seed, with a takt built from a revision; its result is reproduced or not\_reproduced, or error when the command ended with a status the predicate names neither as the defect's nor as the healthy one, or with the defect's exit but without its output, which makes no claim true | `scenario.reproduce`, `scenario.verify` | `scenario.passes_after`, `scenario.reproduced_before` |
| `scorecard_result` | every scenario of the corpus run at the candidate revision and compared with the baseline's record for the same scenario, tokens read from the runs' events only; its result is no\_regression or regression | `scorecard.compare` | `scorecard.no_regression` |

## Claims

Each claim is TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN, established from evidence by its predicate. Missing or stale evidence leaves a claim UNKNOWN, never FALSE.

| Claim | Description | True when |
|---|---|---|
| `finding.cited` | the finding is filed with a predicate that parses and a source that exists | evidence `finding_record` with result `filed` about `finding` |
| `fix.merged` | the current candidate revision is merged into the mainline | evidence `merge_observation` with result `merged` about `candidate` |
| `promoted` | the installed takt binary was built from the merged candidate revision | evidence `promotion_record` with result `promoted` about `promotion` |
| `scenario.passes_after` | the finding's predicate fails on the current candidate revision, observed by another agent run than the one that delivered the candidate | evidence `scenario_result` with result `not_reproduced` about `candidate`, from a producer independent on `different_agent_run` |
| `scenario.reproduced_before` | the finding's predicate holds on the baseline revision | evidence `scenario_result` with result `reproduced` about `baseline` |
| `scorecard.no_regression` | no scenario of the corpus is worse at the current candidate revision than at the baseline | evidence `scorecard_result` with result `no_regression` about `candidate` |

## Obligations

What must be done before a case can be complete, and what discharges it. An obligation stays open until its predicate is TRUE; its predicate being UNKNOWN does not discharge it.

| Obligation | Description | Discharged when |
|---|---|---|
| `regression.required` | the scorecard shows no regression at the candidate | `scorecard.no_regression` is **TRUE** |
| `reproduction.required` | the finding is reproduced on the baseline before a candidate counts | `scenario.reproduced_before` is **TRUE** |
| `verification.required` | the finding is verified gone on the candidate by another run | `scenario.passes_after` is **TRUE** |

## Outcomes

The legitimate terminal interpretations of a case, and what each requires.

| Outcome | Description | Requires |
|---|---|---|
| `abandoned` | the turn closed because it was explicitly abandoned | decision `explicitly_abandoned` |
| `accepted` | the turn closed with the finding verified gone, no regression and the candidate promoted | all of (`promoted` is **TRUE**; `scenario.passes_after` is **TRUE**; `scorecard.no_regression` is **TRUE**) |
| `declined` | the turn closed because the candidate did not move the finding's predicate | evidence `scenario_result` with result `reproduced` about `candidate` |
| `unreproducible` | the turn closed because the finding's predicate does not hold on the baseline | evidence `scenario_result` with result `not_reproduced` about `baseline` |

## Artifacts

The things whose revisions evidence is bound to.

| Artifact | Description |
|---|---|
| `baseline` | the promoted takt revision the finding was observed on |
| `candidate` | a takt revision that is meant to make the finding's predicate fail |
| `finding` | a finding filed in the planning store with its expected\_before predicate (a command, a named scenario, the expected exit status or output) and the path of the record that produced it |
| `promotion` | the takt binary installed for runs, built from a named revision |

## Case inputs

What a case fixes when it opens: each input takes one of the values listed, and is never UNKNOWN.

| Input | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `surface` | whether the candidate's change, base to head, touches a judge surface: every path outside the allow-list held at the baseline revision is one | `judge`, `non_judge` |

## Independence dimensions

What an evidence match may demand of a record's producer (`independent_on`). The case lists, for each producer, the dimensions on which it is independent of the case's work; a match that demands a dimension reads only records whose producer the case lists on it. A record that fails the demand neither establishes nor contradicts the match, so a match only such records would decide is UNKNOWN.

| Dimension | Description |
|---|---|
| `different_agent_run` | the producer is another agent run than the one that delivered the candidate |
